fields.statement: Verified at 0fdec5a0 by reading the diff (internal/dispatch/dispatch.go parseSchedules, dispatch_test.go, dispatch-check.txtar) and running `go test -trimpath -count=1 -v -run 'Schedules|Parse|Load' ./internal/dispatch/` (TestDefaultsWhenNoFile, TestSchedulesAbsent, TestSchedulesRead, TestSchedulesErrors, TestParseErrors all PASS) and `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/dispatch-check$'` (PASS). Covered: missing file and empty or [request]-only content give no schedules; an every+workflow entry reads with defaults catch_up=once, overlap=skip and a cron+command entry reads (that entry sets catch_up=skip/overlap=queue explicitly, so non-default values are checked too; defaults are set by the same per-entry constructor); [request] beside [[schedules]] reads both; unknown table [other] errors naming it; unknown key, duplicate name, every with cron, neither workflow nor command (plus neither every nor cron, both workflow and command), bad cron, every 30s, catch_up=all, overlap=parallel each fail with an error naming schedule "s" and the key. The testscript shows rhiza check passing on a .rhiza/dispatch.toml holding [request] and two [[schedules]], and failing with 'schedule "intake": every' on a 30s entry.
